svg.text: GenAI / ML Standardization Workshop — Services by Lifecycle Stage
Icon view · the AWS services you touch in each stage, Labs 1–5. See architecture.svg for the detailed version.

g.text: Filled square = AWS service icon · white square with teal border = AWS resource icon (a specific capability of the service) · dark tile = non-AWS tool
SageMaker AI appears in several stages because the workshop uses several of its capabilities: Studio, Processing, Training, JumpStart, managed MLflow and Model Registry.
